purpose: Independent read-only visual review of every fresh source2 beta.10 island/external capture; no earlier rendering PASS result is carried forward.
method: Actually viewed all eleven fresh original-pixel 2x2 sheets (all 44 frames) through view_image and image. Independently verified all raw PNG hashes and original-pixel tile identity. Additionally opened fresh raw island-apple-light-he-compact.png directly. Independently validated every one of the 36 nativeBarCaptures against its exact fresh PNG hash and final three compositor samples. No image manipulation was used for visual assessment.
rendering_status_scope: Observed rendering of these exact 44 fresh frames only. All displayed call-island controls, labels and system bars are readable with bounded list/ellipsis observations. No new rendering regression was observed across Apple/Emerald/Glass, light/dark and Hebrew/English. This does not approve the full release.

findings.subject: Former low-contrast saved frame corrected
findings.observed: Fresh raw capture has clearly visible gray time/status and Back/Home/Overview icons on the near-white bars. Island body and underlying Hebrew list remain legible.
findings.limit: This proves the saved fresh capture and its final three stable samples. Earlier raw samples for this capture still record transient absent/noncontrasting bars before settling at 869 ms, so no claim is made that every compositor transition is free of transient bar changes.

findings.observed: Floating keypad overlaps part of a lower visible row call control in compact list captures; long names/dates use ellipsis and lower rows are bounded by the scroll viewport. Expanded island reduces visible list height while favorites/query/summary/navigation remain readable.
findings.limit: No pointer reachability or scrolling behavior is inferred from still images. Raw fixture proof separately records list-anchor restoration.

evidence_context.external_origin: Emulator GSM modem -> Android Telecom -> production PhoneSessionService. No injected Call or session.
evidence_context.fixture_origin: Non-exported DEBUG fixture. Fictional contacts and state; real production renderer/controller. No Telecom call or physical audio route is created.
evidence_context.fixture_main_scope: Actual MainActivity/FastPages contacts and recents, compact/expanded, favorites/summary/navigation, synthetic rows, no call commands
evidence_context.fixture_limit: Style/state demonstrations and MainActivity synthetic-list captures use production rendering/controller but do not establish physical Telecom/audio behavior.
evidence_context.protected_settings: No dedicated protected-Settings PNG is part of these 44. Fresh external native proof records two active checks with Android Settings hiding the overlay, the call preserved and ongoing notification return/hang-up intents. Protected Settings visual appearance is not independently approved here.
evidence_context.external_native_summary: Fresh proof records actual HOME and Clock native windows, SystemUI answer acknowledgement, mute acknowledgement, return/Back/query preservation, end/cancel/confirm/cleanup, denied/regranted overlay permission and modem-end cleanup. Those runtime proof observations remain distinct from screenshot rendering.

speaker.reason: Emulator exposes only the speaker route; native on/off transitions cannot be exercised. Physical private-route/audio verification remains required.

evidence_context.speaker_visual_limit: Actual external expanded PNGs omit unsupported Speaker. Speaker controls shown by DEBUG demonstrations represent fixture capability and are not evidence of real route switching.

release_context.native_expected_failure: testBundledBusinessDirectoryNativeIsolationSearchAndProvenance: bundled licensed production business dataset is MISSING. No native bar test failure is recorded.

not_tested: Protected Settings visual screenshot outside this 44-frame set
